note: terrain.swf class 'background' (sprite 3, one 2886x2467 bitmap fill, shape bounds x 0.15..2886.15, y -0.2..2466.8 px). Full-world backdrop (grass, cliffs, river, beach, sea), NOT a tile. Background.as:256-259 creates it, Background.as:87 addChild at (0,0) of the Background container, beneath the tileset bitmaps. Map area is 90x60 tiles = 2880x1920 px (top-left of map = image pixel 0,0); the extra ~547px at the bottom is beach/sea.
